name: The Super Cyclone
historicalContext: The deadliest cyclone in India's recorded history. 260 km/h winds. 7-meter storm surge. 10,000+ deaths. 15 million people displaced. Entire coastline devastated. Salt water intrusion destroyed farmland for years.

availableCrops.name: Pokkali Rice (Salt-Tolerant)
availableCrops.historicalNote: Ancient Kerala rice variety that thrives in saltwater-flooded fields. The ONLY crop that can survive a cyclone storm surge. GI-tagged heritage variety.

availableCrops.name: Standard Paddy
availableCrops.historicalNote: Odisha's staple rice. Tolerates flooding but NOT saltwater intrusion. Pre-cyclone staple that was wiped out.

availableCrops.name: Coconut Palm
availableCrops.historicalNote: Coastal Odisha plantation crop. Moderate salt tolerance but 260 km/h winds snap trunks. Bunds offer partial protection.

availableCrops.name: Betel Vine (Paan)
availableCrops.historicalNote: Odisha's famous paan cultivation. Delicate creeper destroyed by both wind and salt spray. Total loss in 1999.

availableCrops.name: Hybrid Paddy (Swarna)
availableCrops.historicalNote: High-yield variety pushed by government. Zero salt tolerance. Chemical fertilizer + saltwater = toxic soil. Maximum damage crop.

availableCrops.name: Mixed Vegetables
availableCrops.historicalNote: Kitchen gardens and market vegetables. Completely destroyed by storm surge flooding and salt contamination.

disaster.name: Storm Surge & Salinity Spike — महा चक्रवात
disaster.triggerDescription: The sky turns black. 260 km/h winds howl. A 7-meter wall of saltwater crashes inland. Everything in its path is destroyed. The salt remains long after the water recedes.

specialRules: Salinity spikes to 12-16 dS/m across all plots
If crop.saltTolerance < plot.salinity → yield = 0 (immediate salt rot)
Pokkali Rice survives up to 15 dS/m at 60% yield
If plot.hasBund → salinity reduced by 40% (bund blocks surge)
All non-bunded plots flooded — 50% cash lost to infrastructure damage
Wind destroys crops with resilienceScore < 40 even behind bunds
